# M9: -logos.json reaches every compile, so the diagnostic format is part of
# the action ID of every package, Go packages included. Compile output that
# the build cache replays must never answer a build in the other format.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A Go package with an escape diagnostic: -gcflags=-m prints one line.
cd gomod
logos build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'main\.go:4:2: moved to heap: x'
! stderr '^\{'

# --json-diagnostics prints JSON records, not the cached text.
logos build -gcflags=-m --json-diagnostics .
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*"file":".*main\.go".*"message":"moved to heap: x"'
! stderr 'main\.go:4:2: moved to heap: x'

# Back to text: the JSON output cached by the second build is not replayed.
logos build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'main\.go:4:2: moved to heap: x'
! stderr '^\{'

# A repeat of the JSON build replays JSON.
logos build -gcflags=-m --json-diagnostics .
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*"message":"moved to heap: x"'
cd ..

-- gomod/go.mod --
module example.com/gomod

go 1.27

-- gomod/main.go --
package main

func escape() *int {
	x := 1
	return &x
}

func main() {
	println(*escape())
}
